about: What each episode's title card says, besides the English title, which comes from the episode's own file (data/episodes/<id>.json, `title`). `number` is the episode's number in the session order; `numberJa` is that number in the old formal numerals (第壱話, 第弐話, 第参話...); `titleJa` is the title in Japanese. Rendered with `python tools/title-sequence/render.py card <episode id>`; Foundry plays it from blank-inheritance-video/episode-titles/<episode id>.mp4 after the opening. The Japanese titles are Claude's translations: drafted, for Ingram to check.

episode-c1e1-mothers-maiden-name.note: "Mother's maiden name, once again": 母の旧姓 (haha no kyūsei), mother's maiden name; 再び (futatabi), again.
